description: Build your empire in medieval geopolitical experience where you forge alliances, wage wars, shape history across massive custom world. Join Java or Bedrock players to claim land, trade with kingdoms, create lasting legacies in player-driven economy.
body:
# 🏰  | **Kingdoms MC** |
## Geopolitical Roleplay & Nation Building
- Claim Land. 
- Found Nations. 
- Shape History.

Build your empire from the ground up in this immersive medieval geopolitical experience. Forge alliances, wage wars, trade with rival kingdoms, or maintain peace across a massive custom world where every decision shapes the server's story.

---

 ⚔️ **Key Features**

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| 🗺️ **20k x 20k Custom Map** | Massive terrain with diverse biomes for kingdom building |
| 🏛️ **Lands Plugin System** | Claim territory, manage diplomacy & warfare |
| 💰 **Player-Driven Economy** | Global auction house, dynamic pricing, shop system |
| ⚙️ **Custom Progression** | Lore items, item leveling, enchantments |
| 🎁 **Trial Chambers** | Regenerating vaults with Mending, Windburst, Armor Trims |
| 📦 **Crates & Rewards** | Balanced loot drops, vote keys for free rewards |
| 🌍 **Crossplay Support** | Java & Bedrock players together on one server |
| 🏪 **Quick Sell System** | /sellgui for instant item sales to market |

---

## 🔗 **Connect Now**

```
Java Edition:    kingdomsgp.com (port 25565)
Bedrock Edition: kingdomsgp.com (port 25833)
Discord:         discord.gg/22B9basbcC
BlueMap:         bluemap.kingdomsgp.com
```

---

## ** Why choose us: **

✅ **No Resets** – Your progress and legacy are permanent  
✅ **Not Pay-to-Win** – Fair gameplay for all players  
✅ **Active Community** – Friendly staff & engaged player base  
✅ **24/7 Uptime** – 99% server availability (Germany-hosted)  
✅ **Player Stories Matter** – Every kingdom has a unique narrative  

---

## 📜 **Quick Commands**

- `/lands create` – Create your claim
- `/lands trust [player]` – Invite members to your land
- `/ah sell [price]` – List items on auction house
- `/sellgui` – Quick-sell items to market
- `/market` – Browse & purchase upgrades (Elytras, Totems, Templates)

---

**Kingdoms MC** – Where no building lasts forever, but all legacies last a lifetime. Build your story today.

---
